state: candidate protocol only; no paid launch or efficacy result
review_stage: after shared draft, advisory before optional revision
conditions: same-draft same-evidence normalized advisory report review
backend_axis: Python and pySHACL run on identical packets; identical normalized messages are one LLM treatment, not separate independent outcomes
source_policy: same selected source snapshots in draft and both revisions; no report-triggered lookup or hidden full-source access
gold_policy: reference answers, source-sufficiency labels and adjudications stay outside runtime; no gold repairs

budget_policy.ineligible_admission: retain in planned denominator; do not silently substitute cases

sequence_failure_policy.draft_failed: retain whole planned workflow; mark both dependent revisions not_attempted_due_to_draft_failure
sequence_failure_policy.one_revision_failed: retain that failure independently, never substitute sibling answer
sequence_failure_policy.retries: none without explicit bounded authorization; failures never refunded
sequence_failure_policy.report_generation_failed: retain report error and dependent revision not_attempted_due_to_report_failure; self-review remains independently preparable after common schema admission

evaluation_dimensions.name: primary requested facts
evaluation_dimensions.unit: predeclared question target; source-grounded independent adjudication
evaluation_dimensions.limits: not checker conformance; no truth beyond supplied source scope

evaluation_dimensions.name: projection fidelity
evaluation_dimensions.unit: natural-language propositions versus declared claims, including omitted/compound/misclassified claims
evaluation_dimensions.limits: must not infer complete coverage from empty or all-pass declarations

evaluation_dimensions.name: citation applicability
evaluation_dimensions.unit: claim/source/locator intent, including metadata versus content
evaluation_dimensions.limits: literal pointer-value mismatch is only a review cue

evaluation_dimensions.name: unsupported certainty
evaluation_dimensions.limits: source-wide absence and retrieval omission separate

evaluation_dimensions.name: report usefulness
evaluation_dimensions.unit: question-relevant review pointers, irrelevant warnings, correct warnings and unreviewable cases
evaluation_dimensions.limits: human review time and usefulness need actual human study

evaluation_dimensions.name: revision transitions
evaluation_dimensions.unit: same-draft paired corrected errors, introduced errors, unjustified removals and unchanged cases
evaluation_dimensions.limits: declared revision_log is audited against actual outputs, not taken as truth

scope_limits: consumed source development candidates; no fresh heldout claim
manual two-template semantics; not automatic schema/ontology generation
wrong claim kind or anchor may bypass checks; separate fidelity audit
no SWRL/physical prescriptions, Neptune resources or deployment
no report efficacy claim before actual authorized generation and independent scoring
future_human_input: new bounded paid scope if model execution requested
independent domain expert review remains unmeasured
self_review_preparation: schema admission only, no checker execution; checker-invalid bindings can remain unchanged in self-review input
evaluation_limits: common total budget estimates report-access treatment, not pure content effect isolated from added prompt length
same-row questions and evidence variants are dependent development observations
